$comment: The one contract every APEX website ticket must satisfy to be valid, whoever or whatever filed it: the observer, a staff form, or an agent. The validator (tests/validate-ticket.mjs --contract) rejects tickets that miss it and returns them to the creator, never to a person. The field map (spec/campus-page-field-map.json) is how a filer fills class and owner; the contract itself does not depend on the map.

required.claim: One sentence stating what is wrong, in the form '<Campus> <element> shows X; the rule for state <S> requires Y'. Never 'HubSpot says' unless the field and read time are given.
required.element: Field-map key (for campus pages) or the page section. Carries the CSS ID when known.
required.observed: The value on the public page, verbatim, with the page's modified time.
required.expected: The required value and the rule it comes from (spec path and state).
required.source: System, field, value, and read time of the source of truth that was consulted. 'not read: <reason>' is allowed and must be explicit.
required.owner: Role from spec/responsibilities.json and the person resolved from registry/people.json or the live campus-role resolver, with the APEX user id when assigned.
required.fixPath: Which system changes, by whom, and what publishes it.
required.doneWhen: The observable public condition that closes the ticket, including 'after the next <automation> run' for automation-written elements.
required.evidence: Check name and run id, screenshots, hashes, or the diagnosis file.

optional.history: One line per prior state change: date, actor, what changed. Never the prior bodies.
optional.related: Ticket ids this depends on or duplicates.

storage.apex: Title = claim. Description = the rendered body (tests/render-ticket.mjs). customFields.checkId = class; customFields.defectClass; customFields.ownerRole; customFields.contractVersion; customFields.history (array). assignees = the owner's APEX user only.
storage.bodyRule: The body is regenerated from the contract on every class or owner change. History is appended as one line. Prior bodies are never appended.

returnToCreator.observer: A ticket missing source.field or source.readAt, or carrying suggested owners instead of an owner, is invalid: the observer's config or the check is fixed; the ticket is not worked.
returnToCreator.form: A staff request missing inputs goes back to the requester with the Missing Info template.
returnToCreator.agent: An agent-filed ticket that fails the contract is a defect in the filer; fix the filer.

doneWhenDefaults.wordpress-direct: the public page shows the expected value on the canonical URL after cache clear, ring 2 passes, and the observer rerun clears the check
doneWhenDefaults.n8n-hubspot: the public page shows the expected value after the next 00:15 CT n8n run, and the observer rerun clears the check
doneWhenDefaults.n8n-sheet: the public page shows the expected value after the next 00:15 CT n8n run
doneWhenDefaults.events-plugin: the event appears (or disappears) on /upcoming-events/ and the campus strip after the next 30-minute sync, and the observer rerun clears the check
doneWhenDefaults.sync-mapping: two campuses render correctly after a run with the new derivation, and spec/campus-page-field-map.json is updated
doneWhenDefaults.decision: the decision is recorded in docs/decisions.md and the dependent tickets are re-routed
